content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know how many licenses of [product_name] [version_no] are included in the starter kit for [product_name] [version_no]. I believe it is one, but some people mentioned there might be three. Does anyone have a definitive answer? I would appreciate your insights. Kind regards, [user_name]

I received only one license, which came on a USB stick. You can install the software as many times and on as many computers as you'd like, but there is only a single license. The USB stick lets you easily transfer the license between different computers, but it can only be used on one computer at a time.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking for clarification about the number of [product_name] [version_no] licenses provided in the [product_name] [version_no] starter kit. The information from different sources is inconsistent. Another user confirms that only one license is included, which can be transferred between computers using a USB stick, but only one computer can use it at any given time.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a clear and definitive answer about the number of licenses included in the starter kit and seeks information regarding whether multiple computers can use the license simultaneously.
